embeds.title: 👑 season 2 champion — RatMoe rode to the last dawn
embeds.description:
**it's done. RatMoe is the first player to clear all 45 waves this season.** the drains threw everything they had and the warband didn't break — a full run to the bottom, wave 45, expedition day 3.

**RatMoe · Season 2** — depth **45/45** · **4,608** enemies cut down

the field was right on their heels:
🥈 **Well dressed rat** — wave 43
🥉 **RatKing 👑** — wave 34
4️⃣ CarryRotte — wave 22
5️⃣ Ratinator — wave 22

to everyone still grinding toward the bottom: keep riding. 45 is no longer a myth — it's a target. the board resets clean and **Season 3 rides Monday at 06:00 CET** with new rats waiting in the shop — and word is one of them was cut in a certain champion's honor. sharpen your scrap.

on behalf of the small indie company JelleCorp — gg, RatMoe. 🐀🏆

footer.text: we ride at dawn · season 3 rides monday 06:00 CET
